attempts.text:
**The window starts in a four-column spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `yjgM`, `rraB`, `argF` and `tabA`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 6% of calls. The model names 57 to 99.6% of them, and column 3, `tabA`, is the most hesitant column of the whole window at 3.16 bits.

**Then a short variable stretch.** Columns 4 to 7 carry `arcA`, `bdcR`, `bdcA` and `yjgH`, in a region of plasticity in 15% of calls, and the model names 89 to 98% there. A 28-column spine follows, columns 8 to 35, from `pyrL` to `cysQ` through the `tre` and `ytf` genes, carried by 93 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 15% of calls; the model names 62 to 99%, fewest at column 24, `ytfT`, 62%.

**The graph opens around columns 44 to 52.** These fork and variable columns are in a region of plasticity in 34 to 65% of calls, the most plastic stretch of the window. The model still names 87 to 91%, fewest at column 46, and hesitates most at column 48, 0.65 bits, where a CoA-transferase sits in a fork and `insQ` in 16% of chromosomes. The branches carry their own families: a TetR/AcrR regulator, a TIM barrel protein, and TRAP transporter subunits.

**A seven-column spine follows**, columns 53 to 59, `rplI` to `ulaE`, carried by 92 to 94% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 32% of calls, named 91 to 96%. Then the `ula` genes, columns 60 to 64, mostly persistent, in a region of plasticity in 5 to 7% of calls, named 94 to 96%.

**The window ends in fork and variable columns.** Columns 71 to 79, `yjfM` to `hflK`, are in a region of plasticity in 7 to 11% of calls and named 93 to 95%. At column 79, `hflK`, carried by 29% of chromosomes, the window ends. Across the window the model names 92% of genes at 0.33 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.06 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 75% against 95%.

label: yjgM
facts:
WINDOW: the yjgM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yjgM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,863 to 3,942 from dnaA. Read in 536 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yjgM once); 42,879 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.33 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,213 calls, named 97%, 0.17 bits; shell 9,350 calls, named 79%, 0.78 bits; cloud 316 calls, named 6%, 3.86 bits. Outside an RGP 37,555 calls, named 95%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 5,324 calls, named 75%, 1.06 bits. Columns: 54 spine, 6 fork, 20 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.06 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 95%); 5,324 of the 42,879 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (tabA) 3.16 bits, RGP 6%; column 48 ("CoA-transferase") 0.65 bits, RGP 65%; column 44 ("TetR/AcrR family transcriptional regula…") 0.62 bits, RGP 34%. The 6 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.56 bits on average; the other 74 columns: named 93%, 0.31 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 44-52 (fork and variable columns), RGP 34-65%; the least: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0-6%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-6%. Genes: yjgM "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", rraB, argF, tabA. named 57-99.6% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (tabA), named 57%, 3.16 bits.
2. columns 4-7 (4 columns) variable: RGP 15%. named 89-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 89%, 0.27 bits.
   4: arcA S 9%
   5: bdcR S 85%
   6: bdcA S 85% "SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidore…"
   7: yjgH S 84% "RidA family protein"
3. columns 8-35 (28 columns) spine: share 93-96%, all P, RGP 2-15%. Genes: pyrL, pyrB, pyrI "aspartate carbamoyltransferase regu…", ridA, mgtA, mgtL "mgtA regulatory leader peptide MgtL", treB "PTS trehalose transporter subunit I…", treC, nrdD "anaerobic ribonucleoside-triphospha…", nrdG, cybC, pmbA, yjgA "ribosome biogenesis factor YjgA", mpl, fbp, yjfF "ABC transporter permease subunit", ytfT "ABC transporter permease", ytfR "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", ytfQ "galactofuranose ABC transporter sub…", ppa, ytfP "gamma-glutamylcyclotransferase", tamB, tamA "autotransporter assembly complex pr…", msrA, paeA, ytfK "DUF1107 domain-containing protein", ytfJ "YtfJ family protein", cysQ. named 62-99% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 24 (ytfT), named 62%; most hesitant at column 28 (ytfP), 0.39 bits.
4. column 36 variable: RGP 5%. named 92%; 0.46 bits.
   36: cpdB S 76%
5. columns 37-43 (7 columns) spine: share 93-94%, all P, RGP 4-14%. Genes: ytfH "winged helix-turn-helix transcripti…", qorB, ytfF "EamA family transporter", ytfE "iron-sulfur cluster repair protein…", cycA, fklB, ytfB "LysM-like peptidoglycan-binding dom…". named 89-95% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 37 (ytfH), named 89%, 0.55 bits.
6. columns 44-52 (9 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 34-65%. named 87-91% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 46, named 87%; most hesitant at column 48, 0.65 bits.
   44 variable: "TetR/AcrR family transcriptional regula…" S 68%
   45 variable: "3-ketoacyl-ACP reductase" S 63%
   46 variable: "TIM barrel protein" S 64%
   47 variable: "hypothetical protein" S 63%
   48 fork: "CoA-transferase" S 60%; also insQ S 16%
   49 variable: "FAD-binding protein" S 61%

   51 variable: "TRAP transporter large permease" S 29%
   52 variable: "TRAP transporter substrate-binding prot…" S 30%
7. columns 53-59 (7 columns) spine: share 92-94%, all P, RGP 6-32%. Genes: rplI, rpsR, priB, rpsF, yjfY "DUF1471 domain-containing protein", ulaF, ulaE. named 91-96% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 53 (rplI), named 91%, 0.41 bits.
8. column 60 variable: RGP 5%. named 95%; 0.26 bits.
   60: ulaD P 90%
9. columns 61-62 (2 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 6-7%. Genes: ulaC "PTS ascorbate transporter subunit I…", ulaB. named 94-95% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 61 (ulaC), named 94%; most hesitant at column 62 (ulaB), 0.28 bits.
10. columns 63-64 (2 columns) variable: RGP 7%. named 95-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 63, named 95%; most hesitant at column 64, 0.26 bits.
   63: ulaA P 87%
   64: ulaG P 87%
11. columns 65-70 (6 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 7-11%. Genes: ulaR, yjfP "esterase", bsmA, yjfN "DUF1471 family protease activator Y…", aidB, yjfC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…". named 93-95% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 70 (yjfC), named 93%; most hesitant at column 68 (yjfN), 0.37 bits.
12. columns 71-79 (9 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 7-11%. named 93-95% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 73, named 93%; most hesitant at column 72, 0.36 bits.
   71 variable: yjfM P 87% "DUF1190 domain-containing protein"
   72 variable: yjfL P 88% "DUF350 domain-containing protein"
